import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/lane/MythosMini")
import torch
from src.mythosmini.config import ModelConfig
from src.mythosmini.model.transformer import MythosMini

def load(path):
    payload = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu")
    config = ModelConfig(**payload["model_config"])
    model = MythosMini(config).cuda().eval()
    model.load_state_dict(payload["model"])
    return model, payload.get("name", path)

def generate(model, prompt, max_new=200, temperature=0.8, loops=4, seed=0):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    tokens = list(prompt.encode("utf-8"))
    x = torch.tensor([tokens], device="cuda")
    with torch.no_grad():
        for _ in range(max_new):
            logits = model(x[:, -512:], loops=loops)[0, -1]
            probs = torch.softmax(logits / temperature, dim=-1)
            nxt = int(torch.multinomial(probs, 1))
            if nxt == 256:
                break
            x = torch.cat([x, torch.tensor([[nxt]], device="cuda")], dim=1)
    out = bytes(t for t in x[0].tolist() if t < 256).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return out[len(prompt):]

base, bname = load("runs/20260611_172728/merges/champion.pt")
instruct, iname = load("runs/20260611_172728/merges/instruct_champion.pt")
print("=== BASE champion:", bname[:60])
for p in ["The capital of France is", "Once upon a time, there was a", "Water is made of"]:
    print(f"\nPROMPT: {p!r}")
    print("OUT:", repr(generate(base, p, 120)))

print("\n=== INSTRUCT champion:", iname[:60])
chat = "<|im_start|>user\nWhat is the capital of France?<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n"
chat2 = "<|im_start|>user\nName three animals.<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n"
chat3 = "<|im_start|>system\nYou are a helpful assistant.<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>user\nHow do plants make food?<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n"
for p in [chat, chat2, chat3]:
    print(f"\nPROMPT: {p!r}")
    print("OUT:", repr(generate(instruct, p, 200)))
